comment: Grok's degradation list (D527: its home). A starting list until R2's stage 0 says what Grok hands out: png as the map's self-test, the JPEGs and the lossy WebP a user's file most often is. scripts/grok/run.sh writes the list stage 0's facts give beside its run and says when this one differs; bring this one to the facts then. No profile named, so it serves any Grok source.
